description: This file contains the implementation of a command-line plugin installation process for a software project, including functions for handling plugin sources, configuration, and various installation pathways.

methods.name: resolveInstallMode
methods.description: Determines whether to perform an 'install' or 'update' based on the force flag.

methods.name: resolveInstallSafetyOverrides
methods.description: Creates a safety overrides object, primarily for unsafe install flags.

methods.name: installBundledPluginSource
methods.description: Handles installation of bundled plugin sources, updating plugin load paths.

methods.name: tryInstallHookPackFromLocalPath
methods.description: Attempts to install a hook pack from a local directory path, with optional linking.

methods.name: tryInstallHookPackFromNpmSpec
methods.description: Attempts to install a hook pack from an NPM spec, with optional pinning.

methods.name: isAllowedBundledRecoveryIssue
methods.description: Checks if an issue is permissible during bundled config recovery.

methods.name: buildInvalidPluginInstallConfigError
methods.description: Creates an error object for invalid plugin install configurations.

methods.name: loadConfigFromSnapshotForInstall
methods.description: Loads configuration from a snapshot, applying necessary mutations and checks.

methods.name: loadConfigForInstall
methods.description: Attempts to load current config, falling back to snapshot if invalid.

methods.name: runPluginInstallCommand
methods.description: Main function to process plugin installation commands, handling various sources and fallback strategies.
